{{samename|member of Club Look-See|Club Look-See}} [[File:Martha.png|thumb|250px|Martha]] '''Martha''' (Japanese: '''マーサ''' ''Martha'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[BW101|Drayden Versus Iris: Past, Present, and Future!]]''. She was {{an|Iris}}'s dorm advisor in Opelucid Academy when Iris was young. When Iris returned to Opelucid City to {{pkmn|battle}} [[Drayden]], Martha was present when Iris climbed the big tower in [[Opelucid City]] and got in trouble with [[Officer Jenny]]. Happy to see Iris again, Martha took everyone over to Opelucid Academy to have lunch before Iris's battle. She commented on how Iris was the most troublesome student the academy ever had but she enjoyed Iris's stay anyway. As Iris failed to make friends at the Academy, Martha always cheered her up by making Iris's favorite dish, consisting of [[Oran Berry|Oran]] and [[Pecha Berry|Pecha berries]]. Martha took everyone to Iris's old dorm room, which was currently empty and still had the drawings she made on the wall. After that, she took Iris to see the {{p|Fraxure}} the latter had battled with years prior. Before Iris, {{Ash}}, and {{an|Cilan}} left the city, Martha revealed that Drayden was the one who recommended Iris to leave the academy and go on a {{pkmn|journey}}.
